name: edgar_ownership_reports
description:
Beneficial ownership reports (Schedule 13D for active and 13G for passive holders of more than 5%) filed about a company, from SEC EDGAR (data.sec.gov submissions).
Returns {cik, company_name, form_type, reports_count, reports: [{accessionNumber, filingDate, reportDate, form, primaryDocument, primaryDocDescription, document_url}]}, newest first; document_url is an SEC viewer link.
Inputs (* required): cik* (string, SEC Central Index Key, up to 10 digits; from edgar_company_search), form_type (SC 13D | SC 13G | SC 13G/A | SC 13D/A; default SC 13D), limit (integer 1-100, default 20).
Only the recent-filings block of the EDGAR submissions file is searched. Amendments are separate form types.
Example: {"cik": "0000320193", "form_type": "SC 13G"}
No API key needed (SEC data.sec.gov; 110 ms between requests).
